tast-lint: Allow implementing public methods in test main files. Formerly we disallowed all public functions in test main files regardless of whether they have receivers or not. This kept us from implementing interfaces for private types. Also fixes TestExports_DocFile to properly test the case. BUG=None TEST=fast_build.sh -T Change-Id: I6dece4b65e584cd5baca751bef65eb77ea7d4ee7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1389987 Commit-Ready: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Tested-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org>

arc: Export some useful functions. - Supported allows changing test behavior by whether ARC is supported or not on the board. - WaitAndroidInit allows tests to wait for Android init process to start. - BootstrapCommand allows running commands for a mini container.
